---

> **Before proposing a new aid feature:** the highest-impact contribution is
> usually *not* another application. During an emergency several teams start
> building at once, each with its own database of needs, and the result is more
> fragmentation. Corag publishes an open API precisely so a new interface can be
> a client of the same network — see [/developers](https://cabuya.org/developers).
>
> **Anything we publish must be backed.** Proposals that would put an unverified
> statistic, an unvetted organization, or a channel we do not run on the site
> will be declined — that rule is the project's whole argument.
